escalations: E6 (restated): the Win32-OpenSSH licence is a BSD-style LICENCE in PowerShell/openssh-portable, so the licensing question is closed as factual; the owner decision that remains is whether a Preview-only release line (all 5 latest tags Preview, latest 2025-10-27, source head ahead with OpenSSH 10.3p1 merged) may be a 'supported' Windows OpenSSH baseline.

E8 (new): 27 compressed normalized-text snapshots of third-party docs are committed under docs/sources/snapshots/ for verification. Owner decides whether to keep, replace with hashes plus archive URLs, or remove them before any publication. Only the visible text needed for claim checking is stored; copyright stays with publishers.

E1 (restated, owner wording decision): suggested spec clarification that remembered key approvals can survive a 1Password lock under the timed option while key access still needs unlock. Not a contradiction with spec line 323.
E4 (restated): OpenTUI engines lists bun >=1.3.0 and node >=26.4.0 as separate keys; whether either runtime suffices and how native code loads under Node are inference until G02 tests them.
limitations: Not re-reviewed independently after this fix; status stays implemented_unverified.

Raw-hash stability across hours is shown only for 15 sources (one ~21 h interval vs v1). 13 sources changed raw bytes since v1 and 6 OpenAI/ChatGPT .md pages have no v1 raw hash, so those 19 use the normalized-text hash as primary. Reproducibility of the new baseline was shown over minutes (baseline, repeat, and a third fetch ~3 min later), not over days.
Normalized hashes depend on Python html.parser/unicodedata behavior; baseline produced with Python 3.14.8. A mismatch should be checked against the snapshot before being treated as drift.

archive.org availability API was inconsistent across passes, so absence of an archive URL is not proof of absence; every archive snapshot found predates the pin and only S03's text matches. Archive URLs are hints, not the copy of record. No save requests were made.
Win32-OpenSSH Windows-specific source files were sampled (one file), not audited for licence headers.
OpenTUI runtime/FFI claims, E2 Match exec behavior and Iroh JS on Intel macOS remain untested inference (G02, G07, G09).
Only @opentui/core has a full npm integrity pin; other candidate packages have no integrity or checksum pin yet.
The v1 text_sha256 values are kept only as legacy_text_sha256_unreproducible; the v1 claim that all 34 text hashes matched on re-fetch is withdrawn as unverifiable.
summary: Both major review defects and all listed minors are addressed in docs/sources/** and ADR-0003 (status implemented_unverified, not re-reviewed). (1) Reproducible pins: docs/sources/tools/fetch_pins.py (stdlib, GET only, documented normalizer v1) is committed. Baseline in fetch-baseline.json: 34/34 HTTP 200, raw and normalized sha256 per source. Two back-to-back runs (plus two earlier pairs and a third fetch ~3 min later) gave 34/34 identical raw and normalized hashes, and the 27 snapshot .gz files are byte-identical across runs. Primary pin is raw sha256 for the 15 sources whose v1 raw hash reproduced ~21 h later and normalized-text sha256 for the other 19; GitHub sources are fetched at the pinned commit and all 7 git blob sha1 values match. archive.org (read-only availability GET, two inconsistent passes) found snapshots for only 8 sources, all older than the pin and only S03 matching, so archive URLs are recorded as hints and 27 deterministic compressed normalized-text snapshots are stored in docs/sources/snapshots/ with a copyright/scope README (owner decision E8). The v1 text hashes are kept only as legacy_unreproducible. (2) Win32-OpenSSH now cites PowerShell/openssh-portable (latestw_all, head e581929 2026-09-25, LICENCE blob aeb3017e with the BSD-style text, release repo vs source repo distinguished); E6 restated as a Preview-only support-baseline decision. Minors: S26 excerpt corrected (quote moved to S31); OpenTUI engines recorded as two separate keys with exports conditions and full integrity, with the 'or' reading and Bun-FFI loading labelled inference; S17 drift (commit 9333509) noted with the pin kept at the commit permalink; S27 pin vs tag commit noted; Pigeons telemetry, root service, ~/.ssh/config write, dedicated key and fixture rule recorded (S22 n0 preset default also noted); E1 restated as a suggested spec clarification, not a contradiction.
